description: Asks what CLngLng and CLngPtr (the 64-bit conversion functions) return or raise, and the inner VarType and TypeName of the result: for integer, fractional (half-way), text, Boolean, Date, Currency, Decimal, empty and Null operands, at and one past the signed 64-bit limits (as an exact text and as a numeric literal), and as an operand of +, *, / , \ and Mod. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr), TypeName(expr) FROM One. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
